purpose: Focused retest of Narrator, Benny, and Doctor using the preferred Fish prompt-routing policy established by the prior blind calibration.

identities.label: Narrator
identities.routing_policy: Full Alexandria bracket instructions are the default for expressive Narrator lines.

identities.label: Benny
identities.routing_policy: Concise rich natural-language bracket tags are the default for Benny.

identities.label: Doctor
identities.routing_policy: Doctor defaults to untagged output; bracket control is reserved for genuinely strong delivery requirements.

tests.target_text: There is no need to hurry. We have time to think, and we will use it well.
tests.fish_instruction: calm authority, measured pace, quiet confidence, clear controlled emphasis
tests.alexandria_instruction: Speak with calm, grounded authority: measured pacing, quiet confidence, and clear controlled emphasis without sounding cold.

tests.target_text: Get away from the door now. Do not stop, do not look back, and do not wait for me.
tests.fish_instruction: immediate urgent warning, accelerating pressure, controlled breath, no melodrama
tests.alexandria_instruction: Deliver an unmistakably urgent warning with accelerating pressure and controlled breath, driving every command forward without shouting or melodrama.

tests.target_text: Please listen to me. I am not asking you to forgive me; I am asking you to stay.
tests.fish_instruction: restrained pleading, vulnerable sincerity, fear of being refused, voice kept steady
tests.alexandria_instruction: Speak with restrained, vulnerable pleading: sincere, afraid of being refused, and working to keep the voice steady rather than breaking down.

tests.target_text: The signal returned at last. For the first time all night, she allowed herself to breathe.
tests.fish_instruction: deep controlled relief, tension releasing gradually, warm exhale, not cheerful
tests.alexandria_instruction: Deliver with deep, controlled relief as long-held tension gradually releases; let the warmth arrive on the final thought without becoming cheerful.

tests.target_text: Everyone breathe. We know where the exit is, and panicking will only make the corridor narrower.
tests.fish_instruction: calm practical authority, dry steadiness, reassuring but unsentimental
tests.alexandria_instruction: Speak with calm, practical authority and dry steadiness, reassuring the group without becoming sentimental or grand.

tests.target_text: Move! The ceiling is coming down, and I would rather not become an archaeological layer myself.
tests.fish_instruction: sharp urgent command, breathless danger, dry joke used to keep control
tests.alexandria_instruction: Deliver a sharp urgent command under immediate danger, with a breathless edge and a dry joke used to keep control rather than undercut the threat.

tests.target_text: You call that scholarship? It is theft with footnotes, and not particularly good footnotes.
tests.fish_instruction: controlled intellectual contempt, cutting precision, understated disgust
tests.alexandria_instruction: Speak with controlled intellectual contempt and cutting precision, letting understated disgust sharpen the final phrase.

tests.target_text: Oh, thank heavens. For one terrible minute, I thought I was going to have to improvise.
tests.fish_instruction: audible relief, tension dropping, wry self-mockery, warm but restrained
tests.alexandria_instruction: Let audible relief release the tension, then land the final line with warm, restrained self-mockery.

tests.target_text: No. We are not going to threaten them. We are going to give them one last chance to understand.
tests.fish_instruction: quiet moral authority, patient certainty, danger held in reserve
tests.alexandria_instruction: Speak with quiet moral authority and patient certainty, with the sense that real danger is being deliberately held in reserve.

tests.target_text: Excellent. A locked door, an unstable reactor, and absolutely no reason to worry.
tests.fish_instruction: dry understated sarcasm, amused irritation, precise ironic timing
tests.alexandria_instruction: Deliver with dry, understated sarcasm and amused irritation, using precise ironic timing without broad comedy.

tests.target_text: Run! The field is collapsing, and when it reaches the bridge there will be nothing left to cross.
tests.fish_instruction: sudden urgent command, rising danger, clipped precision, fierce focus
tests.alexandria_instruction: Begin with a sudden, fierce command, then drive the warning with clipped precision and rapidly rising danger while preserving the Doctor's identity.

tests.target_text: I remember every name. That is the trouble with living long enough to say goodbye to all of them.
tests.fish_instruction: old restrained grief, intimate weariness, pain concealed behind control
tests.alexandria_instruction: Speak with old, restrained grief and intimate weariness, keeping deep pain concealed behind deliberate control rather than openly breaking.
